extraction.Name: William Ross
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded July 30, 1918, by William Ross
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Lloyd O. Lamphere for $1000 on October 17, 1918; again mortgaged April 16, 1923, to Charles J. Montgomery for $2500; then on June 24, 1925, the land was conveyed by deed to T. P. Ward for $4500 subject to the mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612738 issued; Northeast quarter section 1, township 95, north of range 77; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee in February 1918; Ross and his wife mortgaged the land; document stamped Rosebud, JUN 1929
